title: ASTRA : Era Of Anguish
description:
THE STORY
Explore the valley of Laywind and unravel a grand mystery. A great incident has set off a chain of events and the ghosts of fallen soldiers now haunt long-dormant lands. A monolithic corporation lurks in the shadows. You are a mysterious unnamed soul whose circumstances remain yet unknown.

Astra: Era Of Anguish is an RPG prequel set in the GOR3 universe.FEATURES
Old School RPG Combat:
To-hit roll combat, Your skill point allocation determines how well you can attack and defend yourself. 

Character Customization: 
Allocate skill points, and customize your appearance. 

Open World Exploration:
Explore a world over 5x the size of Astra. Find sidequests and items; embark on a quest to unravel a grand mystery.

FREE DEMO AVAILABLE NOWPlay the first 20 minutes of the main story!
description_short: Explore the valley of Laywind and unravel a grand mystery.
